channel.title: Questo — Design And Typography
channel.description: Curated dispatches on Design And Typography

item.title: Biophilic Design Architecture
item.description: Incorporating fractal geometries, circadian natural daylighting, living plant walls, and raw organic textures into built environments to lower autonomic stress.
item.author: Julian Rivera

item.title: The Ten Principles of Good Design
item.description: An industrial design philosophy study: functional minimalism at Braun, Vitsœ 606 modular shelving, and Dieter Rams timeless tenet which good design is as little design as possible.
item.author: Elena Vance

item.title: The Logic of Parametric Design
item.description: How visual programming, generative algorithms, and computational physics simulate structural loads and daylighting to shape biomimetic architectural facades.
item.author: Julian Rivera

item.title: The Geometry of Swiss Style
item.description: The revolutionary principles of the International Typographic Style: asymmetric grid mathematics, objective sans-serif typography, and visual clarity.
item.author: Julian Rivera

item.title: The Philosophy of Wabi-Sabi
item.description: The traditional Japanese design ethos of embracing impermanence, asymmetry, rough natural patinas, and the rustic grace of weathered materials.
item.author: Julian Rivera

item.title: The Evolution of Editorial Layout Systems
item.description: A typographic treatise tracing the golden canon of book division, mid-century Swiss asymmetric systems, and modern CSS subgrid fluid editorial architecture.
item.author: Saskia Lindqvist

item.title: Algorithmic Typographic Rhythm
item.description: A digital design theory treatise on modular musical scales, variable font axes, viewport-relative fluid typography, and cognitive reading ergonomics.
item.author: Elena Vance

item.title: The Renaissance of Brutalist Web Design
item.description: How brutalist web aesthetics, high-contrast monospace typography, and unadorned semantic HTML are staging an overdue rebellion against sterile corporate design templates.
item.author: Saskia Lindqvist

item.title: Variable Fonts & Editorial Legibility
item.description: How OpenType variation axes, dynamic optical sizing, and responsive weight modulation are revolutionizing digital magazine typography and reading comfort.
item.author: Saskia Lindqvist

item.title: The Mathematical Elegance of the Swiss Grid
item.description: A deep analysis of Josef Müller-Brockmann's modular layout mathematics, proportional margins, and why the grid remains the foundational grammar of visual communication.
item.author: Saskia Lindqvist

item.title: The Grid as an Instrument
item.description: A masterclass in editorial architecture, analyzing Jan Tschichold's Golden Canon of page division, modular baseline mathematics, and how structural grids transform chaotic content into harmonic literature.
item.author: Saskia Lindqvist
